title: The Little Brother — EN/PT/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar Portuguese Mandarin language learning warm baritone 104bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual family portrait Zimbabwe-Australia
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Joel figured things out quietly.
He came home different.
The little brother did exactly right.

[Verse 2 - Portuguese, with English translations]
Joel resolvia as coisas quietamente. (Joel figured things out quietly.)
Ele voltou para casa diferente. (He came home different.)
O irmão mais novo fez exatamente certo. (The little brother did exactly right.)
O irmão mais novo (The little brother)
Que se revelou ser aquele que sabia. (Who turned out to be the one who knew.)
Joel — que entendeu antes de explicar. (Joel — who understood before he explained it.)
A sala já tinha decidido. (The room had already decided.)
O bom tipo de óbvio. (The good kind of obvious.)

[Chorus - Mandarin, with English translations]
小兄弟 (The little brother)
原来是那个知道的人 (Who turned out to be the one who knew)
小兄弟 (The little brother)
在澳大利亚找到了津巴布韦 (Who found Zimbabwe in Australia)
乔尔——在解释之前就理解了 (Joel — who understood before he explained it)
乔尔——回家时变了 (Joel — who came home different)
小兄弟 (The little brother)
做对了 (Did exactly right)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Jeff and Jill. Everyone in the kitchen. Immediately obvious. The good kind.
Portuguese: Jeff e Jill. Todos na cozinha. Imediatamente óbvio. O tipo bom. (Jeff and Jill. Everyone in the kitchen. Immediately obvious. The good kind.)
Mandarin: 杰夫和吉尔。大家在厨房。立刻显而易见。那种好的显而易见。(Jeff and Jill. Everyone in kitchen. Immediately obvious. The good kind.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Good one. Little brother.
Portuguese: Bem feito. Irmão mais novo. (Good one. Little brother.)
Mandarin: 做得好。小兄弟。(Good one. Little brother.)
